name: FFTA Expansion
notes: Unlocks new teaching-weapon shipments with the original 10- and 20-battle shop upgrades or their story milestones, whichever occurs first. Cyril then stocks 47 and 74 new teaching weapons respectively; the final shipment remains story-gated. Raises 56 later weapon prices to reflect comparable original weapons. The accepted AI follow-up reduces fully learned planning to a 4.19-second mean in the controlled benchmark, with matched choices. Use a normal in-game save and cold Continue after updating.
